title: Polypersona: Persona-Grounded LLM for Synthetic Survey Responses

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the variance and diversity of synthetic survey responses conditioned on 433 distinct demographic and psychographic personas across 10 domains. The framework uses text generation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore), sentiment similarity, and structural metrics to assess whether the models capture genuine population diversity rather than skewing toward WEIRD (Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, Democratic) or socially desirable baseline distributions.

Measuring the distinctness and variation of model outputs across different assigned personas to determine if the fine-tuned LLMs successfully avoid regressing to the mean (i.e., the tendency of standard LLMs to produce homogenous, overly agreeable, or uniform responses regardless of the prompted characteristics).
